task: Annotated-object crop classification on the same 60 development images.
target_selection: Largest clipped annotated box, ties follow source annotation order.
crop: Expand selected clipped box by 25 percent of its width and height on each side, round outward and clip to image bounds.
question_and_scoring: Reuse fixed six-class question, greedy decoding, 12 new tokens, strict full-label parser and all 60 samples in the denominator.
interpretation: Ground-truth boxes supply target location. This separate task diagnoses classification given location and is not directly comparable as unassisted whole-image inference. Cropping changes context and effective resolution.
